SELECT r.id,
    r.ip_type,
    r.origin,
    r.status,
    r.portfolio_status,
    r.record_owner_type,
    r.application_number,
    r.application_date,
    r.registration_number,
    r.registration_date,
    r.renewal_date,
    r.country_code,
    r.wipo_ir,
    r.aripo_ir,
    r.transaction_hierarchy,
    r.parent_id,
    r.created_at,
    r.updated_at,
    td.brand_name,
    td.brand_image_url,
    COALESCE(( SELECT string_agg(p.name, ', '::text ORDER BY a.order_index) AS string_agg
           FROM ip_record_applicants a
             JOIN persons p ON p.id = a.person_id
          WHERE a.ip_record_id = r.id), ''::text) AS applicant_names,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', p.id, 'name', p.name, 'personType', p.type) ORDER BY a.order_index) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ip_record_applicants a
             JOIN persons p ON p.id = a.person_id
          WHERE a.ip_record_id = r.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS applicants_json,
    COALESCE(( SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT c.class_no ORDER BY c.class_no) AS array_agg
           FROM ip_record_classes c
          WHERE c.ip_record_id = r.id), '{}'::integer[]) AS nice_classes
   FROM ip_records r
     LEFT JOIN ip_record_trademark_details td ON td.ip_record_id = r.id;

SELECT p.id AS proposition_id,
    p.authority_id,
    a.authority_key,
    a.authority_type,
    a.jurisdiction,
    a.authority_name,
    a.court,
    a.chamber,
    a.case_no,
    a.decision_no,
    a.decision_date,
    a.title AS authority_title,
    a.short_name,
    a.citation_label,
    a.source_url,
    a.legal_source_id,
    a.source_kind,
    a.source_reliability,
    p.proposition_key,
    p.proposition_text,
    p.holding_text,
    p.verification_excerpt,
    p.verification_sha256,
    p.verification_method,
    p.source_locator,
    p.page_from,
    p.page_to,
    p.paragraph_ref,
    p.source_chunk_id,
    p.source_chunk_index,
    p.legal_issue_tags AS proposition_issue_tags,
    a.legal_issue_tags AS authority_issue_tags,
        CASE
            WHEN cardinality(p.use_for) > 0 THEN p.use_for
            ELSE a.use_for
        END AS use_for,
        CASE
            WHEN cardinality(p.do_not_use_for) > 0 THEN p.do_not_use_for
            ELSE a.do_not_use_for
        END AS do_not_use_for,
    p.quote_safe,
    p.confidence,
    p.embedding,
    p.verified_at,
    p.verified_by,
    p.verified_quote,
    p.quote_locator,
    p.quote_source_url,
        CASE
            WHEN a.authority_type = 'guideline'::text THEN 'guideline'::text
            WHEN lower(concat_ws(' '::text, a.jurisdiction, a.authority_name, a.court, a.chamber, a.title)) ~ '(yargıtay|yargitay)'::text THEN 'tr_yargitay'::text
            WHEN lower(concat_ws(' '::text, a.jurisdiction, a.authority_name, a.court, a.chamber, a.title)) ~ '(türkiye|turkiye|turkey|türkpatent|turkpatent|yidk|bölge adliye|bolge adliye|istinaf)'::text THEN 'tr_other'::text
            WHEN lower(concat_ws(' '::text, a.jurisdiction, a.authority_name, a.court, a.chamber, a.title, a.decision_no)) ~ '(european union|court of justice|general court|adalet divanı|adalet divani|euipo|ecli:eu:)'::text THEN 'eu'::text
            ELSE 'other'::text
        END AS authority_layer
   FROM legal_authority_propositions p
     JOIN legal_authorities a ON a.id = p.authority_id
  WHERE a.status = 'verified'::text AND a.verified = true AND a.citable = true AND p.verified = true AND p.citable = true;

SELECT t.id AS task_id,
    t.task_owner_id AS client_id,
    tbr.application_number AS competitor_app_no,
    tbr.brand_name AS competitor_brand_name,
    tbr.image_url AS competitor_image_url,
    tbr.application_date AS competitor_app_date,
    tbr.nice_classes AS competitor_classes,
    tbr.holders AS competitor_holders,
    mtr.similarity_score,
    mtr.success_chance,
    mtr.note,
    my_ip.id AS my_ip_record_id,
    my_ip.application_number AS my_app_no,
    my_ip.application_date AS my_app_date,
    my_tm.brand_name AS my_brand_name,
    my_tm.brand_image_url AS my_image_url,
    ( SELECT string_agg(p.name, ', '::text ORDER BY a.order_index) AS string_agg
           FROM ip_record_applicants a
             JOIN persons p ON p.id = a.person_id
          WHERE a.ip_record_id = my_ip.id) AS my_applicant_name,
    ( SELECT array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT c.class_no ORDER BY c.class_no), ', '::text) AS array_to_string
           FROM ip_record_classes c
          WHERE c.ip_record_id = my_ip.id) AS my_nice_classes
   FROM tasks t
     LEFT JOIN ip_records comp_ip ON comp_ip.id = t.ip_record_id
     JOIN trademark_bulletin_records tbr ON tbr.application_number = COALESCE(comp_ip.application_number, t.details ->> 'targetAppNo'::text)
     JOIN monitoring_trademark_records mtr ON mtr.bulletin_record_id = tbr.id AND mtr.is_similar = true
     JOIN monitoring_trademarks mt ON mt.id = mtr.monitored_trademark_id
     JOIN ip_records my_ip ON my_ip.id = mt.ip_record_id
     JOIN ip_record_applicants ira ON ira.ip_record_id = my_ip.id AND ira.person_id = t.task_owner_id
     LEFT JOIN ip_record_trademark_details my_tm ON my_tm.ip_record_id = my_ip.id
  WHERE t.task_type_id = '20'::text;

SELECT mn.id,
    mn.subject,
    mn.status,
    mn.created_at,
    mn.is_held,
    mn.to_list,
    mn.cc_list,
    mn.objection_deadline,
    mn.associated_transaction_id,
    mn.source_document_id,
    mn.related_ip_record_id,
    ir.application_number AS app_no,
    tt.alias AS type_text,
    COALESCE(( SELECT p.name
           FROM tasks t
             JOIN persons p ON p.id = t.task_owner_id
          WHERE t.id = tx.task_id
         LIMIT 1), ( SELECT p.name
           FROM ip_record_applicants ira
             JOIN persons p ON p.id = ira.person_id
          WHERE ira.ip_record_id = ir.id
         LIMIT 1), '-'::text) AS client_name,
    mn.associated_task_id,
    mn.triggered_by_user_id,
    mn.sent_by,
    ( SELECT u.display_name
           FROM users u
          WHERE u.id = mn.triggered_by_user_id
         LIMIT 1) AS triggered_by_name,
    ( SELECT u.display_name
           FROM users u
          WHERE u.id = mn.sent_by
         LIMIT 1) AS sent_by_name,
    tsk.status AS task_status,
    td.brand_name
   FROM mail_notifications mn
     LEFT JOIN ip_records ir ON ir.id = mn.related_ip_record_id
     LEFT JOIN transactions tx ON tx.id = mn.associated_transaction_id
     LEFT JOIN transaction_types tt ON tt.id = tx.transaction_type_id
     LEFT JOIN tasks tsk ON tsk.id = mn.associated_task_id
     LEFT JOIN ip_record_trademark_details td ON td.ip_record_id = ir.id
  WHERE mn.deleted_at IS NULL;

SELECT t.id,
    t.title,
    t.description,
    t.task_type_id,
    t.status,
    t.priority,
    t.ip_record_id,
    t.transaction_id,
    t.task_owner_id,
    t.created_by,
    t.assigned_to,
    t.delivery_date,
    t.official_due_date,
    t.operational_due_date,
    t.details,
    t.created_at,
    t.updated_at,
    COALESCE(ip.application_number, s.file_no, t.details ->> 'application_number'::text) AS "iprecordApplicationNo",
    COALESCE(tmd.brand_name, s.title, s.court_name, t.details ->> 'brand_name'::text, t.title) AS "iprecordTitle",
    COALESCE(p_owner.name, p_suit_client.name, p_task_owner.name, t.details ->> 'applicant_name'::text) AS "iprecordApplicantName",
    COALESCE(t.details ->> 'bulletin_no'::text, bull.bulletin_no) AS "bulletinNo",
    COALESCE(t.details ->> 'bulletin_date'::text, bull.bulletin_date::text) AS "bulletinDate",
    t.details ->> 'opposed_mark_owner'::text AS "opposedMarkOwner",
    tx_sub.opposition_owner AS "oppositionOwner",
    ip.record_owner_type AS "recordOwnerType",
    t.details ->> 'epatsDocumentDate'::text AS "epatsDocumentDate",
    ch.client_action_user,
    ch.client_action_type,
    COALESCE(tmd.brand_image_url, t.details ->> 'competitorBrandImage'::text, t.details ->> 'image_url'::text) AS "brandImageUrl",
    COALESCE(ip.origin, s.origin, t.details ->> 'origin'::text) AS "iprecordOrigin",
    COALESCE(ip.country_code, t.details ->> 'country_code'::text) AS "iprecordCountryCode"
   FROM tasks t
     LEFT JOIN ip_records ip ON t.ip_record_id = ip.id
     LEFT JOIN ip_record_trademark_details tmd ON ip.id = tmd.ip_record_id
     LEFT JOIN ip_record_bulletins bull ON ip.id = bull.ip_record_id
     LEFT JOIN ip_record_applicants ipa ON ip.id = ipa.ip_record_id AND ipa.order_index = 0
     LEFT JOIN persons p_owner ON ipa.person_id = p_owner.id
     LEFT JOIN suits s ON t.ip_record_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN persons p_suit_client ON s.client_id = p_suit_client.id
     LEFT JOIN persons p_task_owner ON t.task_owner_id = p_task_owner.id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tx.opposition_owner
           FROM transactions tx
          WHERE tx.task_id = t.id AND tx.opposition_owner IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY tx.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) tx_sub ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT u.display_name AS client_action_user,
            th.action AS client_action_type
           FROM task_history th
             LEFT JOIN users u ON th.user_id = u.id
          WHERE th.task_id = t.id AND (th.action = ANY (ARRAY['client_approval'::text, 'client_rejection'::text]))
          ORDER BY th.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) ch ON true;

SELECT t.id,
    t.title,
    t.description,
    t.task_type_id,
    t.status,
    t.priority,
    t.ip_record_id,
    t.transaction_id,
    t.task_owner_id,
    t.created_by,

    t.delivery_date,
    t.official_due_date,
    t.operational_due_date,
    t.details,
    t.created_at,
    t.updated_at,
    COALESCE(ip.application_number, s.file_no, t.details ->> 'application_number'::text) AS "iprecordApplicationNo",
    COALESCE(tm.brand_name, s.title, t.title, t.details ->> 'brand_name'::text) AS "iprecordTitle",
    COALESCE(p.name, plv.applicant_names, t.details ->> 'applicant_name'::text) AS "iprecordApplicantName",
    b.bulletin_no AS "bulletinNo",
    b.bulletin_date AS "bulletinDate",
    COALESCE(ip.origin, s.origin, t.details ->> 'origin'::text) AS "iprecordOrigin",
    COALESCE(ip.country_code, t.details ->> 'country_code'::text) AS "iprecordCountryCode"
   FROM tasks t
     LEFT JOIN ip_records ip ON t.ip_record_id = ip.id
     LEFT JOIN ip_record_trademark_details tm ON ip.id = tm.ip_record_id
     LEFT JOIN suits s ON t.ip_record_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN persons p ON t.task_owner_id = p.id
     LEFT JOIN portfolio_list_view plv ON t.ip_record_id = plv.id
     LEFT JOIN ip_record_bulletins b ON t.ip_record_id = b.ip_record_id;

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE public.ip_records r
    SET 
        status = 'expired',
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE status = 'renewal - check'
      AND r.renewal_date + INTERVAL '6 months 10 days' < NOW()
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.tasks t
          WHERE t.ip_record_id = r.id
            AND t.task_type_id = '22'
            AND t.status IN ('open', 'awaiting_client_approval')
      );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.build_legal_authority_pack(requested_issue_tags text[], max_propositions integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    tags text[] := coalesce(requested_issue_tags, '{}'::text[]);
    safe_limit integer := greatest(
        1,
        least(
            coalesce(max_propositions, 20),
            50
        )
    );
    result jsonb;
begin
    with relevant_props as (
        select
            v.*,
            coalesce(
                (
                    select bool_or(lma.is_core)
                    from public.legal_module_authorities lma
                    where lma.proposition_id = v.proposition_id
                ),
                false
            ) as is_core,
            coalesce(
                (
                    select max(lma.relevance_score)
                    from public.legal_module_authorities lma
                    where lma.proposition_id = v.proposition_id
                ),
                0.750
            ) as relevance_score,
            (
                select count(*)
                from unnest(
                    coalesce(v.proposition_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
                    ||
                    coalesce(v.authority_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
                ) t
                where t = any(tags)
            ) as tag_hits
        from public.v_citable_legal_propositions v
        where
            cardinality(tags) = 0
            or v.proposition_issue_tags && tags
            or v.authority_issue_tags && tags
    ),
    ranked_props as (
        select *
        from relevant_props
        order by
            is_core desc,
            tag_hits desc,
            case authority_layer
                when 'guideline' then 1
                when 'tr_yargitay' then 2
                when 'tr_other' then 3
                when 'eu' then 4
                else 5
            end,
            relevance_score desc,
            confidence desc,
            decision_date desc nulls last,
            proposition_key
        limit safe_limit
    ),
    covered as (
        select distinct requested_tag as tag
        from unnest(tags) requested_tag
        where exists (
            select 1
            from ranked_props rp
            where requested_tag = any(
                coalesce(rp.proposition_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
                ||
                coalesce(rp.authority_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
            )
        )
    ),
    missing as (
        select distinct requested_tag as tag
        from unnest(tags) requested_tag
        where not exists (
            select 1
            from ranked_props rp
            where requested_tag = any(
                coalesce(rp.proposition_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
                ||
                coalesce(rp.authority_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
            )
        )
    ),
    guideline_covered as (
        select distinct requested_tag as tag
        from unnest(tags) requested_tag
        where exists (
            select 1
            from ranked_props rp
            where
                rp.authority_layer = 'guideline'
                and requested_tag = any(
                    coalesce(rp.proposition_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
                    ||
                    coalesce(rp.authority_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
                )
        )
    ),
    yargitay_covered as (
        select distinct requested_tag as tag
        from unnest(tags) requested_tag
        where exists (
            select 1
            from ranked_props rp
            where
                rp.authority_layer = 'tr_yargitay'
                and requested_tag = any(
                    coalesce(rp.proposition_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
                    ||
                    coalesce(rp.authority_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
                )
        )
    ),
    eu_covered as (
        select distinct requested_tag as tag
        from unnest(tags) requested_tag
        where exists (
            select 1
            from ranked_props rp
            where
                rp.authority_layer = 'eu'
                and requested_tag = any(
                    coalesce(rp.proposition_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
                    ||
                    coalesce(rp.authority_issue_tags, '{}'::text[])
                )
        )
    ),
    matched_modules as (
        select
            m.id,
            m.module_key,
            m.title,
            m.status,
            m.version,
            m.legal_issue_tags,
            m.theory_summary,
            m.application_guidance,
            m.counterargument_guidance,
            m.coverage_weight
        from public.legal_modules m
        where
            m.status <> 'retired'
            and (
                cardinality(tags) = 0
                or m.legal_issue_tags && tags
            )
    )
    select jsonb_build_object(
        'packageVersion', '6.1.6',
        'requestedIssueTags', to_jsonb(tags),
        'coverageScore',
            case
                when cardinality(tags) = 0 then 1.0000
                else round(
                    (select count(*) from covered)::numeric
                    /
                    cardinality(tags)::numeric,
                    4
                )
            end,
        'coveredIssueTags',
            coalesce(
                (select jsonb_agg(tag order by tag) from covered),
                '[]'::jsonb
            ),
        'missingIssueTags',
            coalesce(
                (select jsonb_agg(tag order by tag) from missing),
                '[]'::jsonb
            ),
        'authorityCoverage',
            jsonb_build_object(
                'guidelineCount',
                    (
                        select count(distinct authority_id)
                        from ranked_props
                        where authority_layer = 'guideline'
                    ),
                'yargitayCount',
                    (
                        select count(distinct authority_id)
                        from ranked_props
                        where authority_layer = 'tr_yargitay'
                    ),
                'turkishOtherCount',
                    (
                        select count(distinct authority_id)
                        from ranked_props
                        where authority_layer = 'tr_other'
                    ),
                'euCount',
                    (
                        select count(distinct authority_id)
                        from ranked_props
                        where authority_layer = 'eu'
                    ),
                'guidelineIssueTags',
                    coalesce(
                        (select jsonb_agg(tag order by tag) from guideline_covered),
                        '[]'::jsonb
                    ),
                'yargitayIssueTags',
                    coalesce(
                        (select jsonb_agg(tag order by tag) from yargitay_covered),
                        '[]'::jsonb
                    ),
                'euIssueTags',
                    coalesce(
                        (select jsonb_agg(tag order by tag) from eu_covered),
                        '[]'::jsonb
                    )
            ),
        'modules',
            coalesce(
                (
                    select jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'moduleId', m.id,
                            'moduleKey', m.module_key,
                            'title', m.title,
                            'status', m.status,
                            'version', m.version,
                            'issueTags', m.legal_issue_tags,
                            'coverageWeight', m.coverage_weight,
                            'theorySummary', m.theory_summary,
                            'applicationGuidance', m.application_guidance,
                            'counterargumentGuidance', m.counterargument_guidance
                        )
                        order by m.module_key
                    )
                    from matched_modules m
                ),
                '[]'::jsonb
            ),
        'propositions',
            coalesce(
                (
                    select jsonb_agg(
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'authorityId', rp.authority_id,
                            'authorityKey', rp.authority_key,
                            'authorityType', rp.authority_type,
                            'authorityLayer', rp.authority_layer,
                            'jurisdiction', rp.jurisdiction,
                            'authorityName', rp.authority_name,
                            'court', rp.court,
                            'chamber', rp.chamber,
                            'caseNo', rp.case_no,
                            'decisionNo', rp.decision_no,
                            'decisionDate', rp.decision_date,
                            'authorityTitle', rp.authority_title,
                            'citationLabel', rp.citation_label,
                            'sourceUrl', rp.source_url,
                            'sourceKind', rp.source_kind,
                            'sourceReliability', rp.source_reliability,
                            'propositionId', rp.proposition_id,
                            'propositionKey', rp.proposition_key,
                            'propositionText', rp.proposition_text,
                            'holdingText', rp.holding_text,
                            'verificationExcerpt', rp.verification_excerpt,
                            'verificationMethod', rp.verification_method,
                            'sourceLocator', rp.source_locator,
                            'pageFrom', rp.page_from,
                            'pageTo', rp.page_to,
                            'issueTags', rp.proposition_issue_tags,
                            'useFor', rp.use_for,
                            'doNotUseFor', rp.do_not_use_for,
                            'confidence', rp.confidence,
                            'quoteSafe', rp.quote_safe,
                            'verifiedQuote', rp.verified_quote,
                            'quoteLocator', rp.quote_locator,
                            'quoteSourceUrl', rp.quote_source_url,
                            'isCore', rp.is_core
                        )
                        order by
                            rp.is_core desc,
                            rp.tag_hits desc,
                            case rp.authority_layer
                                when 'guideline' then 1
                                when 'tr_yargitay' then 2
                                when 'tr_other' then 3
                                when 'eu' then 4
                                else 5
                            end,
                            rp.relevance_score desc,
                            rp.confidence desc
                    )
                    from ranked_props rp
                ),
                '[]'::jsonb
            ),
        'generatedAt', now()
    )
    into result;

    return result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_client_bulletin_report(p_report_id uuid, p_bulletin_id text)
 RETURNS SETOF trademark_bulletin_records
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_is_authorized boolean;
    v_client_nos text[];
BEGIN
    -- 1. Yetki Kontrolü
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.client_report_assignments
        WHERE report_id = p_report_id AND user_id = auth.uid()
    ) INTO v_is_authorized;

    IF NOT v_is_authorized THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bu raporu görüntüleme yetkiniz bulunmamaktadır.';
    END IF;

    -- 2. Kriterleri (Aranacak Client Numaralarını) Çek
    SELECT ARRAY(
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(criteria->'client_nos')
    )
    INTO v_client_nos
    FROM public.client_report_configs
    WHERE id = p_report_id;

    -- 3. ZIRHLI ARAMA İŞLEMİ (JSON'a çevirmeden, metni temizleyerek arama yapıyoruz)
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT t.*
    FROM public.trademark_bulletin_records t
    WHERE t.bulletin_id = p_bulletin_id
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM unnest(v_client_nos) AS cno
        -- chr(92) ters eğik çizgiyi (\) temsil eder. Tüm boşlukları ve \ işaretlerini silip net eşleşme arıyoruz.
        WHERE REPLACE(REPLACE(t.holders::text, chr(92), ''), ' ', '') LIKE '%"clientNo":"' || REPLACE(cno, ' ', '') || '"%'
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_task_completion_time_stats()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id text, user_name text, avg_completion_days numeric, min_completion_days numeric, max_completion_days numeric, completed_task_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH completion_times AS (
    SELECT
      t.assigned_to,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (th.created_at - t.created_at)) / 86400.0 AS completion_duration_days
    FROM tasks t
    JOIN task_history th ON t.id = th.task_id
    WHERE
      -- Sadece "tamamlandı" veya "kapatıldı" aksiyonlarını dikkate al
      (th.action LIKE '%completed%' OR th.action LIKE '%closed%')
      AND t.assigned_to IS NOT NULL
      AND t.created_at IS NOT NULL
      AND th.created_at > t.created_at
  )
  SELECT
    ct.assigned_to AS user_id,
    (SELECT u.display_name FROM users u WHERE u.id = ct.assigned_to LIMIT 1) AS user_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ct.completion_duration_days), 2) AS avg_completion_days,
    ROUND(MIN(ct.completion_duration_days), 2) AS min_completion_days,
    ROUND(MAX(ct.completion_duration_days), 2) AS max_completion_days,
    COUNT(*)::int AS completed_task_count
  FROM completion_times ct
  WHERE ct.completion_duration_days IS NOT NULL AND ct.completion_duration_days >= 0
  GROUP BY ct.assigned_to
  HAVING (SELECT u.display_name FROM users u WHERE u.id = ct.assigned_to LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY avg_completion_days ASC;
END;
$function$
functions.return_type: TABLE(user_id text, user_name text, avg_completion_days numeric, min_completion_days numeric, max_completion_days numeric, completed_task_count integer)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_task_distribution_stats()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id text, user_name text, status_counts jsonb, total_tasks bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH user_tasks AS (
    SELECT
      t.assigned_to,
      u.display_name,
      t.status
    FROM tasks AS t
    JOIN users AS u ON t.assigned_to = u.id
    WHERE t.assigned_to IS NOT NULL AND u.display_name IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT
    ut.assigned_to AS user_id,
    ut.display_name AS user_name,
    jsonb_object_agg(
      ut.status,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM user_tasks WHERE assigned_to = ut.assigned_to AND status = ut.status)
    ) AS status_counts,
    count(*) AS total_tasks
  FROM user_tasks ut
  GROUP BY ut.assigned_to, ut.display_name
  ORDER BY total_tasks DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_task_distribution_stats(start_date_param date DEFAULT NULL::date, end_date_param date DEFAULT NULL::date, task_type_param text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id text, user_name text, status_counts jsonb, total_tasks bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH user_tasks AS (
    SELECT
      t.assigned_to,
      u.display_name,
      t.status
    FROM tasks AS t
    JOIN users AS u ON t.assigned_to = u.id
    WHERE 
        t.assigned_to IS NOT NULL 
        AND u.display_name IS NOT NULL
        AND (start_date_param IS NULL OR t.created_at >= start_date_param)
        AND (end_date_param IS NULL OR t.created_at <= end_date_param)
        AND (task_type_param IS NULL OR t.task_type_id = task_type_param)
  )
  SELECT
    ut.assigned_to AS user_id,
    ut.display_name AS user_name,
    jsonb_object_agg(
      ut.status,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM user_tasks WHERE assigned_to = ut.assigned_to AND status = ut.status)
    ) AS status_counts,
    count(*) AS total_tasks
  FROM user_tasks ut
  GROUP BY ut.assigned_to, ut.display_name
  ORDER BY total_tasks DESC;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_task_details(user_id_param text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    task_stats jsonb;
    completion_stats jsonb;
    recent_tasks jsonb;
    user_info jsonb;
    result jsonb;
BEGIN
    -- 1. Kullanıcı Bilgisi
    SELECT to_jsonb(u)
    INTO user_info
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.id = user_id_param
    LIMIT 1;

    -- 2. Görev Dağılımı (Statülere Göre)
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'status_counts', COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(status, count), '{}'::jsonb),
        'total_tasks', COALESCE(SUM(count), 0)
    )
    INTO task_stats
    FROM (
        SELECT status, count(*) as count
        FROM tasks
        WHERE assigned_to = user_id_param
        GROUP BY status
    ) AS status_subquery;

    -- 3. Görev Tamamlama İstatistikleri
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'avg_completion_days', ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (th.created_at - t.created_at)) / 86400.0), 2),
        'completed_task_count', COUNT(*)
    )
    INTO completion_stats
    FROM tasks t
    JOIN task_history th ON t.id = th.task_id
    WHERE t.assigned_to = user_id_param
      AND (th.action LIKE '%completed%' OR th.action LIKE '%closed%')
      AND th.created_at > t.created_at;

    -- 4. Son 10 Aktif Görev
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'id', t.id,
            'title', t.title,
            'status', t.status,
            'due_date', t.operational_due_date
        )
    )
    INTO recent_tasks
    FROM (
        SELECT id, title, status, operational_due_date
        FROM tasks
        WHERE assigned_to = user_id_param
          AND status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'closed')
        ORDER BY created_at DESC
        LIMIT 10
    ) AS t;

    -- Tüm verileri birleştir
    result := jsonb_build_object(
        'user', COALESCE(user_info, '{}'::jsonb),
        'task_distribution', COALESCE(task_stats, '{"total_tasks": 0, "status_counts": {}}'::jsonb),
        'completion_stats', COALESCE(completion_stats, '{"avg_completion_days": 0, "completed_task_count": 0}'::jsonb),
        'recent_tasks', COALESCE(recent_tasks, '[]'::jsonb)
    );

    RETURN result;
END;
$function$

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
    select
        p.id,
        a.id,
        a.authority_key,
        a.authority_type,
        a.jurisdiction,
        a.authority_name,
        a.court,
        a.chamber,
        a.case_no,
        a.decision_no,
        a.decision_date,
        a.title,
        a.source_url,
        p.proposition_key,
        p.proposition_text,
        p.holding_text,
        p.source_locator,
        p.page_from,
        p.page_to,
        p.paragraph_ref,
        p.legal_issue_tags,
        a.legal_issue_tags,
        case when cardinality(p.use_for) > 0 then p.use_for else a.use_for end,
        case when cardinality(p.do_not_use_for) > 0 then p.do_not_use_for else a.do_not_use_for end,
        p.quote_safe,
        (1 - (p.embedding <=> query_embedding))::double precision
    from public.legal_authority_propositions p
    join public.legal_authorities a on a.id = p.authority_id
    where p.embedding is not null

      and (

          or cardinality(issue_tags) = 0
          or p.legal_issue_tags && issue_tags
          or a.legal_issue_tags && issue_tags
      )
      and (1 - (p.embedding <=> query_embedding)) >= match_threshold
    order by p.embedding <=> query_embedding
    limit greatest(1, least(match_count, 50));

        FROM public.monitoring_trademark_records r
        WHERE r.monitoring_type = 'international'
          AND r.monitored_trademark_id::text = OLD.id::text
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Bu yurtdışı izleme kaydına bağlı sonuçlar bulunduğu için kayıt silinemez: %',
            OLD.id
            USING ERRCODE = '23503';
    END IF;

    RETURN OLD;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_legal_module_statuses()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    active_count integer;
    draft_count integer;
begin
    update public.legal_modules m
    set
        status = case
            when exists (
                select 1
                from public.legal_module_authorities lma
                join public.v_citable_legal_propositions v
                  on v.proposition_id = lma.proposition_id
                where lma.module_id = m.id
                  and lma.is_core = true
            )
            then 'active'
            else 'draft'
        end,
        updated_at = now()
    where m.status <> 'retired';

    select count(*) into active_count
    from public.legal_modules
    where status = 'active';

    select count(*) into draft_count
    from public.legal_modules
    where status = 'draft';

    return jsonb_build_object(
        'packageVersion', '6.1.2',
        'activeModules', active_count,
        'draftModules', draft_count
    );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_handle_accrual_task_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
-- DURUM A: Görev yeni tamamlandıysa (completed)
IF NEW.status = 'completed' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed' THEN
    
    UPDATE tasks
    SET 
    status = 'open',
    updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE details->>'parent_task_id' = NEW.id
    AND task_type_id = '53'
    AND status = 'pending';

-- DURUM B: Görev "tamamlandı" statüsünden geri alındıysa (re-open)
ELSIF OLD.status = 'completed' AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed' THEN
    
    UPDATE tasks
    SET 
    status = 'pending',
    updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE details->>'parent_task_id' = NEW.id
    AND task_type_id = '53'
    AND status = 'open';
    
END IF;

RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_unlock_evaluation_mail()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Eğer güncellenen görev 66 (Değerlendirme) tipindeyse VE statüsü yeni 'completed' olmuşsa
  IF NEW.task_type_id = '66' AND NEW.status = 'completed' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed' THEN
    
    -- Bu görevin bağlı olduğu PDF işlemine ait 'evaluation_pending' durumundaki maili serbest bırak
    UPDATE public.mail_notifications
    SET 
        status = 'awaiting_client_approval'
        -- Hata veren updated_at = NOW() satırını buradan kaldırdık!
    WHERE associated_transaction_id = NEW.transaction_id
      AND status = 'evaluation_pending';
      
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_update_leave_balance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Sadece 'Yıllık İzin' türündeki talepler bakiyeden düşer
    IF NEW.leave_type = 'Yıllık İzin' THEN
        
        -- 1. YENİ ONAY: 'pending' veya 'rejected' durumundan 'approved' durumuna geçiş
        IF NEW.status = 'approved' AND OLD.status != 'approved' THEN
            UPDATE public.user_leave_balances
            SET used_annual_leave = used_annual_leave + NEW.requested_days,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
        
        -- 2. İPTAL / RED: 'approved' durumundan 'cancelled' veya 'rejected' durumuna geçiş (İADE)
        ELSIF OLD.status = 'approved' AND NEW.status != 'approved' THEN
            UPDATE public.user_leave_balances
            SET used_annual_leave = used_annual_leave - OLD.requested_days,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;

        -- 3. DÜZENLEME: Zaten 'approved' iken yönetici GÜN SAYISINI değiştirirse (FARKI YANSIT)
        ELSIF OLD.status = 'approved' AND NEW.status = 'approved' AND OLD.requested_days != NEW.requested_days THEN
            UPDATE public.user_leave_balances
            SET used_annual_leave = used_annual_leave - OLD.requested_days + NEW.requested_days,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
        END IF;

    END IF;
    
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
